# Welcome! {#index .unnumbered}

```{r indx, include=F}
source("00_libpath.R")
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
```

This is the new (permanent)[^intro1] home of my course script introducing GradAB and IAB colleagues to R, with a focus on the IAB server environment and their special challenges when installing packages and ensuring reproducibility.

[^intro1]: Permanent is relative, of course - what really is forever?
 
```{r main, echo = F, out.height="70%",out.width="70%", fig.align="center"}
knitr::include_graphics("./pic/01_frontpage_iab2.png")
```

I update the script for each new course to keep everything current with server requirements, 
helper functions, and R package versions.
